title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18

ai_review.summary: A wildly energetic 9/18/70 Dead show with stellar Dark Star and St. Stephen, captured on a modest‑quality audience recording.
ai_review.review: Fans describe this September 1970 performance as an unforgettable, midnight‑to‑sunrise marathon filled with teases, weaving jams and standout moments like Dark Star and St. Stephen. While the playing and song selection are praised as “awesome,” the audio is noted as less than ideal – a rough audience capture with some extra tracks pulled from other sources.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic fan comments rate the musical performance near‑perfect (mostly 5 stars) while recording quality is described as only fair; weighted combination yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality isn’t great; reviewers note the need to use an AUD source for the NRPS set and extra bits, and some tracks are from other dates. Overall capture is usable but not crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows beautifully with endless teasing and weaving, a long midnight‑to‑dawn stretch, and spontaneous jams that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his presence and playing (“Jerry with New Riders”, great tone), central to the show’s excitement.
